task_statement: propose, once per observation, whether to dispatch an action, using only the recent derived RGB views of the panel ROI, so that no action is dispatched while the panel reports unavailable and as many actions as possible are dispatched while it reports available
learnable_component: one small temporal model that predicts the panel state one observation ahead; the deterministic Router turns that prediction into the applied gate and the model never sends anything
feedback_caveat: the panel signal passed under an owner-authorized bar, not an independent verification, and the discrete-state structural test still reports not_resolvable_at_this_cadence; R1 may compare candidates but may not claim the feedback is independently verified

target.name: panel_state_one_step_ahead
target.derivation: the frozen two-statistic label of the next persisted frame
target.authorship: measured by the frozen rule on a future frame, so the label is neither model-authored nor visible to the policy input

baseline.name: myopic_persistence
baseline.rule: predict the next state as the current measured state and dispatch if and only if it reports available

data.source: read-only bounded capture on the owner-authorized route; the capture sends no device input and adds no input transport
data.split: by episode; no frame from a held-out episode may appear in training
data.label_authorship: frozen statistic rule applied to the next persisted frame

primary_metric: held-out one-step-ahead panel-state accuracy and the resulting wrong-phase dispatch count
retain_rule_if: the candidate fails the pre-declared accuracy gain, or its wrong-phase dispatch count is not lower than the baseline's, or the ambiguous-step fraction exceeds the frozen bound
